_metadata.comparison_note: Design-characteristic comparison only — NOT experimental performance. Tools use different chemistries (HG Lab uses Chen 2005 stem-loop RT-qPCR; miRprimer/miPrimer use linear RT primers). Compares in-silico design metrics only (Tm, GC%, structure ΔG, predicted specificity, design success rate, speed). Wet-lab PCR efficiency comparison requires self-generated calibration data (see calibration/calibration_data_requirement.md).
